info.description:
This module defines the top level WiFi Configurations for a list of Access Points.

**Module:** `openconfig-access-points`
**Root nodes:** access-points
**Paths:** 142 | **Operations:** 349

GET/PUT/PATCH/DELETE for config nodes, GET-only for state (config false) nodes.
